content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital products

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete digital commerce stack built on open protocols and owned tools. It replaces platforms like Stripe, Gumroad, and PayPal with a combination of free and paid components that you control. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. This architecture is not a workaround—it is base-layer infrastructure. Once deployed, no third party can suspend your account, freeze your funds, or restrict your access based on geography. You own the code, the data, and the payment flow. This is infrastructure sovereignty.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates in layers. The frontend is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process orders and trigger file deliveries. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on the stack. Payments are verified via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee. When a payment confirms on-chain, a webhook fires, updating the order status and delivering the product via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. No buyer account is required. No KYC. No platform dependency. The system is stateless and self-hosted—you own every component after deployment.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or unreliable. Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines are prime examples. Creators in these regions sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products. They cannot use Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Lemon Squeezy. Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives them a permanent alternative. It is designed to withstand currency collapse, payment rejection, and financial isolation. This is not a solution for the excluded—it is a better architecture for everyone.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure replaces platforms with owned architecture—no geographic locks, no suspensions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack serves a specific function. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, globally distributed hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files instantly. These components integrate via APIs and webhooks. For example, a payment confirmation on NOWPayments triggers a webhook that updates the order in Supabase and sends a download link via email. The system is modular—you can replace any component without breaking the stack. This is how infrastructure sovereignty works.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing a stack based on your needs. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) uses GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) upgrades to Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. Both stacks are deployed in 48 hours with 30-day support. If you prefer to build yourself, purchase The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete documentation and source code. For full access to all blueprints and templates, buy the Complete Builder Kit ($197). Every product is available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This is not a tutorial—it is a deployment plan for infrastructure sovereignty.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure. This replaces Stripe with a combination of free and paid tools that you own. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. This architecture is not dependent on any platform or geography. Once deployed, you control the entire payment flow—no suspensions, no freezes, no restrictions.
NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee—no buyer account required, no KYC.

Creators searching for Stripe alternatives in Nigeria or Gumroad replacements in restricted countries will find sovereign commerce infrastructure a permanent solution. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a fully deployed example of this architecture, using Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. It includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. For those who prefer to build, The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation and source code. All products are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose a stack based on your needs—Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Provide your product details and payment wallet address. Receive your deployed stack in 48 hours. Test the payment flow end-to-end. Load your products into the system. Configure your domain and email settings. Launch your storefront. Monitor orders via Supabase or Google Sheets. Withdraw payments directly to your wallet. Own your infrastructure permanently.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I have no technical skills?
Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you. You receive a fully functional store with 30-day support. No technical skills required.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON—all under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need a domain name?
A domain name is recommended for professionalism. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability.
Can I scale this system as my business grows?
Yes. The architecture is modular and stateless. You can replace components as needed. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) includes a scaling playbook.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is a payment processor, not a platform dependency. If it fails, replace it with another crypto payment gateway. You own the integration code.
